instruction: Run `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\osc.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\osc.out`, `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\osc_measure.txt`, and `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\osc.dat`. The native sweep tests five candidate feedback capacitors. From `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\osc_measure.txt`, choose the smallest `C_FB` whose overshoot is at most `10%`, where `overshoot_pct = (|Vmin| - |Vfinal|) / |Vfinal| * 100`. Then write `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\stabilize.json` with `best_C_FB_pF`, `Vfinal_V`, `Vmin_V`, `overshoot_pct`, `meets_10pct_overshoot`, and `n_candidates`.
source: PSpice native compensation sweep for a capacitive-load feedback stage
